topic: How Airlines Use Dynamic Pricing to Charge You More

script.title: Airline Ticket Prices: Why You Pay More Than Your Seatmate
script.hook: Why did your seatmate pay half price for your exact flight?

scenes.text: Why did your seatmate pay half price for your exact flight?

motion_action.headline: SAME FLIGHT, DIFFERENT PRICE
motion_action.subtext: The secret behind airline ticket prices

scenes.text: Airlines do not charge fixed prices for seats anymore.
They use dynamic pricing algorithms that track demand in real time.
If search volume spikes, prices jump instantly.
The algorithm even tracks browser cookies and device location.

motion_action.title: ALGORITHM DATA LOG
motion_action.highlight_text: TRACKING USER DATA AND SEARCH HISTORY

scenes.text: Business travelers who book late are forced to pay maximum rates.
Meanwhile, vacation buyers who search early get targeted with lower teaser rates.

motion_action.headline: EARLY BIRD DISCOUNTS
motion_action.subtext: Filling seats early to lock in revenue

scenes.text: It is called yield management, designed to extract every dollar possible.
